name: Varlariel

abilities.name: Frost Breath
abilities.description: Basic melee attack dealing very high frost damage in an cone.

abilities.name: Rain of Wisps
abilities.description: The wispmother summons a volley of wisps that crash into the ground all around the arena, indicated by numerous red circles, dealing very-high frost damage each.

abilities.name: Mother Clone
abilities.description: Varlariel can split into four clones of herself to divert attention from the party. The clones' health do not scale with Varlariel's current Health. "Combustion/Infused Combustion" always occurs after this.

abilities.name: Combustion/Infused Combustion
abilities.description: Some time after "Mother Clone", an non-avoidable arena-wide explosion occurs which scales with how many clones are still alive:

notes: "Varlariel" translates to "Beauty [of the] Stars" in Ayleidoon.
related_quests: The Mage's Tower: Defeat the Celestial Mage to save her from the Serpent.
summary: Varlariel is a wispmother acting as the third boss of the Aetherian Archive.
